race.comment: The runners with the superior exposed form all come out so this looks like being fought out by first starters. The contingent is headed by SHOWZEL (9) from the Bjorn Baker yard. Snitzel filly who has been to the trials twice and won them both. Ready to make an immediate impact. Exceed And Excel filly AROMATHERAPY (7) is trialling well for Ciaron Maher and should present ready to run well on debut. The Joe Pride-trained MERVEGA (3) lines up for the first time. Has been easily accounted for in three trials although the most recent appearance was the pick of them. Market the best guide. BINIT (11) has minor claims after a reasonable return at Muswellbrook last start. Hard to make much of a case for the other runners.
